details.problem: The website's legacy infrastructure on DigitalOcean was slow, difficult to maintain, and suffered from an inefficient CI/CD pipeline, resulting in poor site performance and slow development cycles.
details.solution: I modernized the frontend by refactoring class components to use React Hooks and translated Figma designs into performant components. I also migrated the backend to Firebase and completely overhauled the CI/CD pipeline, replacing Docker-Compose with a more efficient GitHub Actions workflow.

impact.text: Reduction in build and deployment times (from 8 minutes to 4 minutes average)
Improvement in site rendering speed (reduced First Contentful Paint from 2.1s to 1.8s)
Reduction in deployment failures (from 12% failure rate to 9% through improved CI/CD pipeline)
